rationale: This is the final iteration, so the priority is an approved build that races unchanged. The Evaluator's latest review (entityR1, iteration 4) approved the iteration 1 build field for field and said a revision cannot fit the remaining run budget. Every race so far has ended the same way: all trials went off track, exactly one line-loss event occurred per run, max_error sat at the 0.06 m limit, and progress stayed between 0.10 and 0.17. Gain changes (ki 0.4 to 1.0) moved progress only slightly. Widening the outer sensors to +/-0.045 m (iteration 3) scored lower at 56.65. Iteration 1 is the best raced build at 62.18. Its controller is ki 0.4, kp 2.5, kd 0.2, base_speed 1.4, line_loss last_direction, with weights [2, 1, 0, -1, -2] and sensors at x = +/-0.03 m (outer) and +/-0.015 m (inner). I am resubmitting that build unchanged. The Evaluator's conditional changes (line_loss search_right, base_speed 1.5 to 1.6, kp 2.2) depend on race results from this iteration, which I cannot see before I must deliver. Any untested change could lose approval and leave the final race unscored. Expected result: about the iteration 1 score, roughly 60 to 62 on the development tracks, with one line-loss event per run and progress near 0.17. Hypotheses for the record: (a) the single line loss happens at the start of the run or at the first sharp bend, not from a steady offset; (b) line_loss search_right may recover better than last_direction; (c) base_speed of about 1.5 may be needed for a sub-3 s finish once a run completes. Measurements to watch: where in the run the line loss occurs (progress at the loss), max_error per track, completion_time for any finish, and steering_oscillation.
